{"metadata":{"description":"Lazy MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness: one stable proxy tool instead of N tool schemas, servers connect on first use and idle out, metadata cached to disk.","id":"gh:1365064934","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-mcp-lazy","slug":"wings1848/dsh-mcp-lazy","topics":["deepseek","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm","mcp","model-context-protocol","tokens"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Lazy MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness: one stable proxy tool instead of N tool schemas, servers conn"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ect on first use and idle out, metadata cached to disk."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-mcp-lazy"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A lazy MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness. It puts **one** tool in front of the model instead of N MCP"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" tool schemas: servers start on first use, idle out again, and their tool metadata is cached on disk"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" so `search` and `describe` never spawn anything."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` connects every configured server at startup and registers every one of"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" its tools as a native tool. As its own README puts it, tool descriptions and input schemas "enter e"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"very request while the tools are registered". A handful of servers therefore costs thousands of toke"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ns on every request and one resident child process each — whether or not the model ever calls them."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This plugin keeps the model-facing surface at exactly one tool whose schema never changes, discovers"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" tools on demand from a disk cache, and only spawns a server when a call needs it."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## The numbers"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Measured against `chrome-devtools-mcp@1.6.0` (29 tools), both sides rendered the same way — JSON byt"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"es of the tool definitions, then four bytes per token:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| | per request |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| native registration | 21252 bytes ≈ **5313 tokens** | | this gateway | 1525 bytes ≈ **381 tokens**"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" | | saved | **92.8%** |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The gateway figure is constant: configuring ten more servers does not move it, because their schemas"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" are read on demand rather than sent every request."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**The honest counterweight.** The gateway costs a fixed 1525 bytes, so it wins only when a server's "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rendered tool definitions exceed that. The bundled fixture offers 7 small tools and the saving drops"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" to 1.7%. A server with a couple of tiny tools would make the gateway a net loss. Measure your own b"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ver with a couple of tiny tools would make the gateway a net loss. Measure your own before assuming:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Works with the DeepSeek Harness `0.1.5-rc` and `0.2.0-rc` lines (verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`); the"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" package's peer ranges declare exactly that."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"That installs the package into the profile and registers its bundle patch, which inserts the `mcp-la"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"zy` row. Then give it your servers in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Restart the profile. Every field is documented in docs/configuration.md."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Moving servers off `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Every writer of MCP configuration in this ecosystem emits a `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row: the c"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"onfig-manager panel hardcodes that package name, `@hyzyn/dsh-codegraph` writes a managed row, and a "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"hand-written config follows the same convention. Such a row registers each MCP tool as a real tool, "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"so its schemas enter every request — and a server listed in **both** places cancels the saving this "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"plugin exists for, with no error and nothing to notice. (The `mcp({})` status output does warn you —"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" for any server the other plugin serves natively, whether or not this one has it too — which is how "},{"id":"p21s7","text":"you usually find out.)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`adopt` does the move for you:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Or, without leaving the session, as a slash command:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The command drives the same CLI, so the plan, the backups and the write are one code path; a success"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ful `apply` is followed by a re-plan whose result is shown to you, so the answer to "did it work?" i"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s evidence rather than an assurance. It still requires the human to type it: nothing runs at plugin "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ce rather than an assurance. It still requires the human to type it: nothing runs at plugin startup."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"It reads what is *actually* mounted (`dsh --profile

--dump-config`, so all four patch layers are"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" composed), marks each original row `disabled: true` **in place**, and appends the server to this pl"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ugin's `servers` list. Nothing else in the file is touched — comments, blank lines and `!!js` expres"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"sions are preserved byte for byte — and a row it cannot move safely is reported [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## What the model sees"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"One tool, always the same 11 parameters:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Seven of the 11 are the actions above. The other four shape a `search` and are never needed for anyt"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"he 11 are the actions above. The other four shape a `search` and are never needed for anything else:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Parameter | Meaning | Default | Limit |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| `regex` | Treat `search` as a regular expression rather than literal text. | `false` | — | | `incl"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"udeSchemas` | Include each match's parameter summary in the result. | `true` | — | | `limit` | How m"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"any matches to return. | `12` | `40`; clamped into 1–40, never an error | | `offset` | Skip this man"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"y matches, for paging through a long result. | `0` | — |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"That one tool is the **whole** model-facing surface by default. `directTools` is the opt-in that pro"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"motes chosen server tools into real native tools instead — see docs/configuration.md for what it acc"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"epts, and why the default is the cheap choice."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The v1 boundary, stated plainly:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **Tools only.** No MCP resources, prompts, sampling, or elicitation. Only `tools/list_changed` is "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"subscribed. - **No OAuth.** Authentication is a plaintext `headers` entry or an environment variable"},{"id":"p37s3","text":". - **Image and audio results are not forwarded.** They are projected to a one-line metadata entry ("},{"id":"p37s4","text":"type and byte count). Forwarding pixels needs attachment storage this plugin does not implement. - *"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"*No approval gate.** MCP calls follow your DSH permission preset. - **No config interop.** It reads "},{"id":"p37s6","text":"DSH-native config only; it will not import `.mcp.json`, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or VS Code serve"},{"id":"p37s7","text":"r lists. - **The regex guard is deliberately narrow.** A 256-character cap plus a nested-quantifier "},{"id":"p37s8","text":"check, which does **not** catch overlapping alternation like `(a|aa)+` or polynomial backtracking li"},{"id":"p37s9","text":"ke `a*a*a*b`. A full analyser would mean a second runtime dependency. - **No SSE or unix-socket tran"},{"id":"p37s10","text":"sports.** `stdio` and `streamable-http` only. - **`npx` is not resolved to the underlying binary**, "},{"id":"p37s11","text":"so an `npx`-launched server costs one extra Node parent process. - **A secret passed through `args` "},{"id":"p37s12","text":"lands in the child's `argv`**, where `ps` and `/proc//cmdline` can read it. That path exists on"},{"id":"p37s13","text":"ly because some servers accept a token no other way; `envFrom` alone keeps the value out of `argv`."}],"truncated":true}
